column1: # declared explanation classes of the MSVC equivalence gate (tools/equiv/explain.py; docs/EQUIVALENCE.md, D24)
# A class listed here is a DECLARED difference: its functions do not count against "0 wrong functions" (D24), for the
# reason given. A class of explained.tsv that is not listed here is OPEN: its code functions count, and so does every
# no-build unit (the prepared side compares nothing there; a no-build class is never declared).
# declared: platform (the target's platform differs from the PC's on purpose: CRT, link, allocator), compiler (MSVC
# 2008's code generation of an equivalent spelling; measured, the target compiler does not see it), by-design (a
# deliberate fix, PATCHES.md / a rule verdict).

column3: reason
identical when both sides build with /EHs-c-: MSVC's EH frames and unwind states only; the target has its own EH model
EH frame only, plus one reload of an image-bound const (C++ linkage, LINK1): the same value
the CRT function where the exe calls the game's forwarding wrapper of it (the relocation pairs are checked)
MSVC header's inline C++ overload where the exe calls the game's out-of-line copy of it (std::abs(float) 0x00408840 -> 0x00408860 = (float)fabs((double)x)); the same value for every input
the CRT function bound where the decomp's namespace copy of it was (memset, free through its import slot): the same operation
MSVC's inline form of a CRT call (constant-size memcpy -> rep movsd) with the CRT's declaration
the same function under another MSVC decoration (ANON1 names an unnamed return struct): the link binds by address

link by address (D20) needs image-bound variables with external linkage (STATIC1): MSVC reloads one after a call where an internal static stayed in a register; the same value: the variable was internal in the original, so only this unit's code writes it

MSVC 2008 null-checks the result of every new-expression before the constructor, also for an allocation function without throw() (measured, docs/EQUIVALENCE.md "Stream EQ"); GCC -O2 emits no check: the target code is the explicit constructor call's
new[] reaches the global operator new[] (ALLOC1 removes the unit's MemoryManager copy on the target; the global one forwards to MemoryManager)
S1b's deliberate fixes (docs/PATCHES.md, by-design table)
a deliberate decomp-bug fix (UNIT1 verdict: the stack object passed to std::exception grows 8 -> 12 bytes)
a function address compared with 0: MSVC emits `ja` for the unsigned compare and `jne` for the != spelling; CF is 0 there, the same branch
x87 operands commuted (IEEE add / multiply commute), jumps shifted
MSVC 2008 x87 keeps a float in extended precision on one spelling only; AArch64 has none (FLT_EVAL_METHOD 0), so the target rounds where the exe did
an exact SSE operation with its operands through another register
the same multiset of instructions with the blocks in another order (MSVC merges GOTO2's cloned tails again)
MSVC /Ob1 inlines a unit's own inline function once the spelling around it changes: the same bodies
MSVC's own _SCL_SECURE_VALIDATE in place of the decomp's copy: a dead `xor ecx,ecx; jne` after each _invalid_parameter_noinfo call
